title: Gumbel convergence for maximal packing distances from uniform random samples
summary: Let $(X _n )_n$ be a sequence of i.i.d. $R^d$-valued random variables uniformly distributed on a compact subset $M$ of $R^d$ . In this work, we study the asymptotic behavior of maximal packings of this compact subset $M$. Under some assumptions on $M$ (in particular, that it is a smooth submanifold of $R^d$ without boundary), we establish a precise extreme value law (of Gumbel type) for the minimal distances from the sample $(X_1 , \cdots, X_ n)$ to the centers of maximal packings.
